what: Portable CRUD rejects native floating-point values
expected: Native finite floating-point values insert and read unchanged
observed: Generated schema rejects 1e20 accepted by SQLite
root_cause: effectSchemasFor uses the pinned Drizzle rc.5 floating-point schemas with integer-sized limits, rejecting valid native float/double data before writes and after reads
fixed_by: Refine signed/unsigned floating-point contracts to IEEE float32/float64 finite ranges, preserving generator null/default/update metadata and array dimensions

invariants: Native large finite floats preserve insert, update, persisted read values; malformed input does not mutate rows

environment.revision: 0dbc3c445664d53c79d54c3e3e69628f039e6842 plus reviewed specialized migration and these scoped fixes
environment.target: Local Bun SQLite and generated HTTP host
environment.monitoring: Existing specialized Effect operation logs inspected in local test output; no external monitoring queried
